/* isry.cysns.casemng.casereg.mapper.selectReqById3 - Hee Sung Yoon */ SELECT A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , A.TRPR_INFO_NO , A.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO , A.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD , A.RELA_INST_NM , A.TRPR_CHAR_SE_CD , A.BEFFAT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.BEFFAT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.BEFFAT_CHILDR_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.BEFFAT_GAMBLE_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.ADDTNG_TRL_INSP_ENFORC_YN , A.ADDTNG_INSP_PTCPTN_YN , A.CNTER_ADDTNG_INSP_YN , A.PTCPTN_ATFINO , A.CNTER_ATFINO , A.MDLRT_SPRT_YN , A.MDLRT_RESULT_OPIN_CN , A.CMPN_OPIN_CN , A.PIC_OPIN_CN , A.AFTFCT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.AFTFCT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.AFTFCT_CHILDR_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.AFTFCT_GAMBLE_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.LTRN_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.LTRN_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.LTRN_CHILDR_DGNSS_SE_CD , A.LTRN_GAMBLE_DGNSS_SE_CD , DECODE(A.MEDIAA_SCHL_SE_CD, NULL, DECODE(B.MEDIAA_SCHL_SE_CD, NULL, C.STDNT_AGE_NM, B.MEDIAA_SCHL_SE_CD), A.MEDIAA_SCHL_SE_CD) AS SCHL_SE_CD FROM ACA200 A, ACA210 B, ACA400 C WHERE A.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO = B.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO(+) AND A.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO = C.DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO(+) AND A.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO}
mapper.update: /* isry.cysns.casemng.casereg.mapper.saveData - Hee Sung Yoon */ MERGE INTO ACA130 USING DUAL ON (CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND CRISIS_SCRENN_SCORE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_SCRENN_SCORE_SE_CD}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CRISIS_SCRENN_EVL_SCORE = #{CRISIS_SCRENN_EVL_SCORE}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE, LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CASE_MNG_NO, CASE_MNG_ODRNO, CRISIS_SCRENN_SCORE_SE_CD, CRISIS_SCRENN_EVL_SCORE, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{CASE_MNG_NO}, #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO}, #{CRISIS_SCRENN_SCORE_SE_CD}, #{CRISIS_SCRENN_EVL_SCORE}, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )

/* isry.cysns.casemng.casereg.mapper.saveData2 - Hee Sung Yoon */ MERGE INTO ACA120 USING DUAL ON (CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CRISIS_SCRENN_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_SCRENN_SE_CD}, RISK_FCTR_SUM_SCORE = #{RISK_FCTR_SUM_SCORE}, RISK_FCTR_DGREE_SE_CD = #{RISK_FCTR_DGREE_SE_CD}, CRISIS_PROBM_SUM_SCORE = #{CRISIS_PROBM_SUM_SCORE}, CRISIS_PROBM_DGREE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_PROBM_DGREE_SE_CD}, GNRLZ_CRISIS_DGREE_SE_CD = #{GNRLZ_CRISIS_DGREE_SE_CD}, CRISIS_SCRENN_MEMO_CN = #{CRISIS_SCRENN_MEMO_CN}, INSP_YMD = #{INSP_YMD}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE, LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CASE_MNG_NO, CASE_MNG_ODRNO, CRISIS_SCRENN_SE_CD, RISK_FCTR_SUM_SCORE, RISK_FCTR_DGREE_SE_CD, CRISIS_PROBM_SUM_SCORE, CRISIS_PROBM_DGREE_SE_CD, GNRLZ_CRISIS_DGREE_SE_CD, CRISIS_SCRENN_MEMO_CN, INSP_YMD, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{CASE_MNG_NO}, #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO}, #{CRISIS_SCRENN_SE_CD}, #{RISK_FCTR_SUM_SCORE}, #{RISK_FCTR_DGREE_SE_CD}, #{CRISIS_PROBM_SUM_SCORE}, #{CRISIS_PROBM_DGREE_SE_CD}, #{GNRLZ_CRISIS_DGREE_SE_CD}, #{CRISIS_SCRENN_MEMO_CN}, #{INSP_YMD}, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )

/* isry.cysns.casemng.casereg.mapper.saveData3 - Hee Sung Yoon */ MERGE INTO ACA200 USING DUAL ON (CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET LINK_TYPE_SE_CD = #{LINK_TYPE_SE_CD}, RELA_INST_NM = #{RELA_INST_NM}, TRPR_CHAR_SE_CD = #{TRPR_CHAR_SE_CD}, BEFFAT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD = #{BEFFAT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD}, BEFFAT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD = #{BEFFAT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD}, BEFFAT_CHILDR_DGNSS_SE_CD = #{BEFFAT_CHILDR_DGNSS_SE_CD}, BEFFAT_GAMBLE_DGNSS_SE_CD = #{BEFFAT_GAMBLE_DGNSS_SE_CD}, ADDTNG_TRL_INSP_ENFORC_YN = #{ADDTNG_TRL_INSP_ENFORC_YN}, ADDTNG_INSP_PTCPTN_YN = #{ADDTNG_INSP_PTCPTN_YN}, CNTER_ADDTNG_INSP_YN = #{CNTER_ADDTNG_INSP_YN}, PTCPTN_ATFINO = #{PTCPTN_ATFINO}, CNTER_ATFINO = #{CNTER_ATFINO}, MEDIAA_SCHL_SE_CD = #{SCHL_SE_CD}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE, LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CASE_MNG_NO, CASE_MNG_ODRNO, TRPR_INFO_NO, DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO, LINK_TYPE_SE_CD, RELA_INST_NM, TRPR_CHAR_SE_CD, BEFFAT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD, BEFFAT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD, BEFFAT_CHILDR_DGNSS_SE_CD, BEFFAT_GAMBLE_DGNSS_SE_CD, ADDTNG_TRL_INSP_ENFORC_YN, ADDTNG_INSP_PTCPTN_YN, CNTER_ADDTNG_INSP_YN, PTCPTN_ATFINO, CNTER_ATFINO, MEDIAA_SCHL_SE_CD, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{CASE_MNG_NO}, #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO}, #{TRPR_INFO_NO}, #{DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO}, #{LINK_TYPE_SE_CD}, #{RELA_INST_NM}, #{TRPR_CHAR_SE_CD}, #{BEFFAT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD}, #{BEFFAT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD}, #{BEFFAT_CHILDR_DGNSS_SE_CD}, #{BEFFAT_GAMBLE_DGNSS_SE_CD}, #{ADDTNG_TRL_INSP_ENFORC_YN}, #{ADDTNG_INSP_PTCPTN_YN}, #{CNTER_ADDTNG_INSP_YN}, #{PTCPTN_ATFINO}, #{CNTER_ATFINO}, #{SCHL_SE_CD}, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )
